confirmed-mismatch.label: Legal Record Updated, Managed Services Not Updated
confirmed-mismatch.description: The legal name change is complete and has taken effect. Managed Services still uses the previous name, which is needed for upcoming work. No correction activity exists.

already-current.label: Managed Services Already Updated
already-current.description: The verified Managed Services record already contains Demo Entity Beta LLC, matching the current legal record.

field-not-consumed.label: Change Does Not Affect Upcoming Work
field-not-consumed.description: Managed Services still uses the previous name, but upcoming work does not depend on it. No current operational finding is supported.

service-ended.label: Managed Service No Longer Active
service-ended.description: The Managed Service is no longer active. This review covers the service's upcoming work, not any separate legal obligations.

change-cancelled.label: Legal Change Cancelled
change-cancelled.description: The legal change was cancelled. It does not support a request to update the Managed Services record.

never-effective.label: Legal Change Never Took Effect
never-effective.description: The legal change had not taken effect as of the review date.

missing-new-value.label: Current Legal Value Missing
missing-new-value.description: The current legal name is missing. Confirm it before comparing the legal and Managed Services records.

missing-completion-evidence.label: Legal Change Cannot Be Verified
missing-completion-evidence.description: Evidence confirming that the legal change was completed is missing. The stated change status alone is insufficient.

identity-mismatch.label: Entity Match Cannot Be Confirmed
identity-mismatch.description: The Managed Services record refers to a different legal entity. Similar names alone cannot confirm that the records belong to the same entity.

stale-evidence.label: Available Evidence Is Outdated
stale-evidence.description: The supplied legal record evidence is marked as outdated. Obtain current evidence before relying on it.

conflicting-evidence.label: Sources Contain Conflicting Information
conflicting-evidence.description: The supplied Managed Services evidence is marked as conflicting. Confirm the correct information before deciding whether a correction is needed.

pending-owned-task.label: Correction Already In Progress
pending-owned-task.description: An assigned owner is responsible for correcting this entity's name, with completion planned before upcoming work begins. The records still differ; monitor the existing correction.

overdue-task.label: Correction Delayed, Review Needed
overdue-task.description: The planned correction date has passed, and Managed Services still uses the previous name. Follow up with the assigned owner.
overdue-task.setupNote: This scenario includes an earlier finding from when the correction was on track. The review updates that finding.

replay-identical.label: Previously Reviewed Situation
replay-identical.description: These facts have already been reviewed and remain unchanged. The existing finding is retained without a duplicate notification.
replay-identical.setupNote: This scenario includes the earlier finding so you can see how a repeated review is handled.

replay-corrected.label: Managed Services Record Corrected
replay-corrected.description: Newer verified evidence confirms that Managed Services now uses the current name. The earlier finding is marked as no longer current, and the evidence history is retained.
replay-corrected.setupNote: This scenario includes the earlier finding about the previous name. The review records the correction against that finding.

similar-name-other-entity.label: Similar Entity, No Issue Found
similar-name-other-entity.description: A different legal entity with a similar name already has the correct Managed Services record. The other entity's finding does not apply to it.
similar-name-other-entity.setupNote: The other entity's finding remains in the history. This review concerns only the selected legal entity.
